howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Matrix 适配器从 channels 分支拷进 src/channels/、在通道入口注册它、安装固定版本的适配器依赖、修补 matrix-js-sdk 的 ESM 导入，并跑构建和注册测试。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目加上 Matrix 频道时接管；它按 Apply 里的步骤执行，每条步骤幂等，可安全重跑。

say.text: 帮我给项目加上 Matrix 频道
say.note: 会从 channels 分支拷入适配器并构建验证

say.text: 用访问令牌给 Matrix 机器人配好环境变量
构建报 matrix-js-sdk 模块找不到，帮我修

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the Matrix adapter from the `channels` branch into `src/channels/`, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned `@beeper/chat-adapter-matrix` dependency, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then runs build and registration tests.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to add a Matrix channel to the project; it runs the Apply steps, which are idempotent and safe to re-run.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and runs the build

say_en.text: Set up the bot's Matrix credentials with an access token
The build fails on matrix-js-sdk module resolution
say_en.note: Re-runs the ESM patch, then builds
